layer-editor.layer-groups.clicks-go-to-w.text: Clicks go to whatever is under this module.
layer-editor.layer-groups.clicks-go-to-w.note: Help text under the click-through switch when it is on.

layer-editor.layer-groups.clicks-reach-t.text: Clicks reach the modules in front. This module's own action is off while this is on.
layer-editor.layer-groups.clicks-reach-t.note: Help text under the click-through switch warning that the module's tap action stops working.

layer-editor.layer-groups.colour.note: Field label for the darkening colour in module Placement (black, white or custom).

layer-editor.layer-groups.copied.note: Brief confirmation on the Copy YAML button after the text went to the clipboard.

layer-editor.layer-groups.copy-yaml.note: Button in module Placement that copies the placement settings as YAML.

layer-editor.layer-groups.cost-on-older-.note: Label before the cost tag (light, medium, heavy) in the module Placement effects section.

layer-editor.layer-groups.covers-name-at.text: Covers {name} at this width. Taps on the overlap go to this module.
layer-editor.layer-groups.covers-name-at.note: Overlap warning. {name} is the name of another module this module sits on top of at the current card width.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.custom.note: Option for choosing your own value instead of a preset, such as a custom darkening strength.

layer-editor.layer-groups.custom-colour.note: Option and field label for picking any colour for the darkening, besides black and white.

layer-editor.layer-groups.darken-behind-.note: Section title and switch for the dark fade (scrim) over a placed picture.

layer-editor.layer-groups.distance-from-.text: Distance from the {anchor} position. Enter 0 or more: the module stays inside the card.
layer-editor.layer-groups.distance-from-.note: Help text for an offset field. {anchor} is the chosen anchor edge or corner, such as 'top left' or 'bottom'. It is lower case and sits mid-sentence.

vars.anchor: The value that replaces anchor in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.distance-from-.text: Distance from the centre. Negative values move it left or up.
layer-editor.layer-groups.distance-from-.note: Help text for the offset fields when a module is anchored to the centre.

layer-editor.layer-groups.effects-and-da.note: Heading of the collapsible group with blur, blend and Darken behind text in module Placement.

layer-editor.layer-groups.enter-0-or-mor.text: Enter 0 or more: the module stays inside the card.
layer-editor.layer-groups.enter-0-or-mor.note: Validation hint for an offset field that rejects negative numbers.

layer-editor.layer-groups.enter-a-distan.text: Enter a distance in px or %.
layer-editor.layer-groups.enter-a-distan.note: Validation error for an offset field that is not a number with px or % unit.

layer-editor.layer-groups.even.note: Darkening option: the same strength across the whole picture, with no fade.

layer-editor.layer-groups.fills.note: Status word in the Placement summary: the module fills its container (verb, not a noun).

layer-editor.layer-groups.fills-the-whol.text: Fills the whole container behind the other modules and takes no space. To put a picture behind the whole card, use Card backdrop on the card's Design tab.
layer-editor.layer-groups.fills-the-whol.note: Explanation of the Behind others placement choice.

layer-editor.layer-groups.floats-over-th.text: Floats over the container at a fixed spot and takes no space.
layer-editor.layer-groups.floats-over-th.note: Explanation of the On top placement choice.

layer-editor.layer-groups.forward.note: Module Placement: move this module one step in front of the next sibling in the stack.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-bottom.note: Short offset field label: distance from the bottom edge of the container, in a compact layout.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-left.note: Short offset field label: distance from the left edge of the container, in a compact layout.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-right.note: Short offset field label: distance from the right edge of the container, in a compact layout.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-the-botto.note: Full offset field label: distance from the bottom edge. Same English as From bottom, used where there is room.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-the-centr.note: Offset field label for a module anchored at the centre: distance from the middle of the container.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-the-left.note: Full offset field label: distance from the left edge. Same English as From left, used where there is room.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-the-right.note: Full offset field label: distance from the right edge. Same English as From right, used where there is room.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-the-top.note: Full offset field label: distance from the top edge. Same English as From top, used where there is room.

layer-editor.layer-groups.from-top.note: Short offset field label: distance from the top edge of the container, in a compact layout.

layer-editor.layer-groups.front.note: Stacking position of a module in Placement: in front of its siblings.

layer-editor.layer-groups.heavy.note: Lower-case cost tag in module Placement: an effect that is demanding for older tablets.

layer-editor.layer-groups.its-container.note: Option for what a placed module is measured against: the container (column, tab or card) it sits in.

layer-editor.layer-groups.its-row.note: Option for what a placed module is measured against: the row it sits in.

layer-editor.layer-groups.keyboard-order.text: Keyboard order: top positions come first, bottom positions after the normal modules. For touch, aim for 44 px or more.
layer-editor.layer-groups.keyboard-order.note: Accessibility tip in module Placement about tab order and touch target size.

layer-editor.layer-groups.large-text-onl.note: Contrast verdict: the colours reach a 3:1 ratio, enough only for large text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.layer.note: Noun for a placed module seen as a layer in the stack, used in row and list labels.

layer-editor.layer-groups.let-clicks-and.text: Let clicks and taps go through
layer-editor.layer-groups.let-clicks-and.note: Label of the click-through switch in module Placement.

layer-editor.layer-groups.light.note: Darkening strength option (a gentle fade). Capitalised, unlike the lower-case cost tag light.

layer-editor.layer-groups.light-2.note: Lower-case cost tag in module Placement: an effect that is cheap for older tablets.

layer-editor.layer-groups.live-camera.note: Lower-case cost tag in module Placement: the module streams live video.

layer-editor.layer-groups.looks.note: Heading of the ready-made placement looks in module Placement; picking one fills in the settings.

layer-editor.layer-groups.low-power-mode.text: Low-power mode drops blur, blend and pan and zoom for this card and keeps the pictures.
layer-editor.layer-groups.low-power-mode.note: Warning tip in module Placement explaining what the card-wide Low-power mode removes.

layer-editor.layer-groups.medium.note: Darkening strength option (a middle fade). Capitalised, unlike the lower-case cost tag medium.

layer-editor.layer-groups.medium-2.note: Lower-case cost tag in module Placement: an effect with moderate cost for older tablets.

layer-editor.layer-groups.move-name-back.note: Icon button label on a module layer row; moves it one step towards the back. {name} is the module's name. Pairs with 'Move {name} to the back', which jumps all the way.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.move-name-forw.note: Icon button label on a module layer row; moves it one step towards the front. {name} is the module's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.move-name-to-t.note: Menu or button action that sends a module behind all others in one go. {name} is the module's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.move-name-to-t.note: Menu or button action that brings a module in front of all others in one go. {name} is the module's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.n.text: {n, select, 1 {1st from the front, of {count}} 2 {2nd from the front, of {count}} 3 {3rd from the front, of {count}} other {{n}th from the front, of {count}}}
layer-editor.layer-groups.n.note: Accessible position of a module in the stacking order. {n} is the position counted from the front (1 is topmost); {count} is the number of modules. The select form only picks ordinals in English; adapt freely.

vars.count: The value that replaces count in the text.
vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.n-set.note: Badge on a collapsed section. {n} is the number of options in it that have a value. 'Set' means configured, not the verb to place.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.normal.note: Placement option: the module keeps its usual place in the layout, with no stacking changes.

layer-editor.layer-groups.nothing-else-i.text: Nothing else is in this container, so this module shows in the normal place until you add one.
layer-editor.layer-groups.nothing-else-i.note: Info shown when a module is set Behind others but is alone in its container.

layer-editor.layer-groups.on-top.note: Module Placement option: the module floats over its container at a fixed spot.

layer-editor.layer-groups.opacity.note: Field label for how see-through a placed module is (CSS opacity).

layer-editor.layer-groups.order.note: Field label for the stacking order of a placed module among its siblings.

layer-editor.layer-groups.pan-and-zoom.note: Lower-case cost tag in module Placement: the picture slowly moves and zooms.

layer-editor.layer-groups.placement.note: Name of the module section for stacking and pinning a module. Referred to by name in other help texts.

layer-editor.layer-groups.position.note: Field label for where a module is pinned in its container, shown with the anchor grid.

layer-editor.layer-groups.show-yaml.note: Button in module Placement that reveals the placement settings as YAML.

layer-editor.layer-groups.smaller-than-a.text: Smaller than a fingertip (44 px). Add padding in Design.
layer-editor.layer-groups.smaller-than-a.note: Touch-target warning for a pinned module that measures under 44 px.

layer-editor.layer-groups.strength.note: Field label for how dark the Darken behind text fade is.

layer-editor.layer-groups.strong.note: Darkening strength option, stronger than Medium and weaker than Very strong.

layer-editor.layer-groups.strong-blur-ca.text: Strong blur can make older tablets slow.
layer-editor.layer-groups.strong-blur-ca.note: Performance warning under the blur field in module Placement.

layer-editor.layer-groups.style.note: Name of the card's Style section (colour and image), referred to in Placement help texts.

layer-editor.layer-groups.takes-its-norm.text: Takes its normal place in the column.
layer-editor.layer-groups.takes-its-norm.note: Explanation of the Normal placement choice.

layer-editor.layer-groups.tapping-name-w.text: Tapping {name} will do nothing while this is on.
layer-editor.layer-groups.tapping-name-w.note: Help text for a switch that makes a module ignore taps. {name} is the name of the module that is covered; 'this' is the switch.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.text-hard-to-r.text: Text hard to read? Darken behind text
layer-editor.layer-groups.text-hard-to-r.note: Link or prompt shown when contrast is low; it turns on the Darken behind text option.

layer-editor.layer-groups.text-is-readab.note: Contrast verdict: the colours pass for normal-sized text.

layer-editor.layer-groups.the-whole-card.note: Option for what a placed module is measured against: the full card, not only its container.

layer-editor.layer-groups.this-layer-has.text: This layer has no action, so it only blocks taps.
layer-editor.layer-groups.this-layer-has.note: Info shown for a covering module without a tap action that still catches pointer input.

layer-editor.layer-groups.this-module.note: Lower-case inline phrase that refers to the module being edited, used inside a longer sentence.

layer-editor.layer-groups.this-module-ke.text: This module keeps its own action.
layer-editor.layer-groups.this-module-ke.note: Help text under the click-through switch when it is off.

layer-editor.layer-groups.this-video-bac.text: This video background sits behind its siblings on its own, as before. Choose an option to set it.
layer-editor.layer-groups.this-video-bac.note: Info for a camera module from an older config that was placed behind others automatically.

layer-editor.layer-groups.tint-only-not-.note: Contrast verdict: the colours are too close for readable text, fine only for a tint.

layer-editor.layer-groups.to-back.note: Module Placement action: send this module to the very back of the stack.

layer-editor.layer-groups.to-front.note: Module Placement action: bring this module to the very front of the stack.

layer-editor.layer-groups.turn-on-low-po.note: Button in a Placement warning that switches on the card-wide Low-power mode.

layer-editor.layer-groups.undo.note: Button that reverts the last change to module Placement.

layer-editor.layer-groups.very-strong.note: Darkening strength option, the strongest preset, above Strong.

layer-editor.layer-groups.white.note: Choice of darkening colour for Darken behind text; the opposite is Black.

layer-editor.layer-groups.with-a-black-d.text: With a black darkening of 60 % or more, white text stays readable on any picture. This holds for the fully dark part. With a fade, text must sit in the strongest third from that edge.
layer-editor.layer-groups.with-a-black-d.note: Contrast explanation under Darken behind text; keep the 60 % threshold as written.

layer-editor.layers-sheet.front-first-ta.text: Front first. Tap one to select it.
layer-editor.layers-sheet.front-first-ta.note: Help text in the Layers here sheet, which lists layers at the selected place from front to back.

layer-editor.layers-sheet.layers-here.note: Title of the sheet listing the stacked layers at the spot where the user tapped.

layer-editor.layers-sheet.n-from-the-fro.text: {n, select, 1 {1st} 2 {2nd} 3 {3rd} other {{n}th}} from the front here
layer-editor.layers-sheet.n-from-the-fro.note: Position of a module in the layers sheet. {n} is the position counted from the front (1 is topmost). 'Here' means in this sheet.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

layer-editor.layers-sheet.nothing-here.note: Empty state of the Layers here sheet when no layer is at the tapped spot.

layer-editor.looks.camera-still-picture.note: Name of a ready-made backdrop look that shows a refreshed camera snapshot.

layer-editor.looks.colour-wash.note: Name of a ready-made backdrop look: a soft, see-through tint of one colour.

layer-editor.looks.corner-badge.note: Name of a ready-made look: a small module pinned in one card corner.

layer-editor.looks.dimmed-backdrop.note: Name of a ready-made look: a picture with a dark layer over it so content stands out.

layer-editor.looks.dotted-texture.note: Name of a ready-made look: a subtle dot pattern behind the card.

layer-editor.looks.frosted.note: Name of a ready-made look: a blurred, frosted-glass effect over what is behind.

layer-editor.looks.photo-dark-at-the-bot.note: Name of a ready-made look: a photo with a fade to dark at its lower edge for text.

layer-editor.looks.picture-behind-button.note: Name of a ready-made look: a picture filling the container behind a row of buttons.

layer-editor.looks.soft-glow.note: Name of a ready-made look: a blurred radial light behind the content.

layer-editor.looks.soft-vignette.note: Name of a ready-made look: edges that fade darker towards the corners.

layer-editor.looks.top-banner.note: Name of a ready-made look: a wide module fixed along the top edge of the container.

layer-editor.looks.weather-backdrop.note: Name of a ready-made look: a backdrop that changes with a weather entity state.

layer-editor.mc-anchor-grid.position.note: Accessible name of the 3x3 anchor grid used to choose which corner or edge a module sticks to.
